Middle East.headline: Red Sea — Four crew killed in suspected Houthi attack on cargo ship
Middle East.body: Four crew members were killed in a suspected Houthi attack on an Egyptian-owned cargo vessel in the Bab el-Mandeb strait. The strike marks a deadly escalation in maritime attacks in the region amid high regional tensions. Separately, a container ship off Pakistan was struck by a missile in a suspected United States attack, as broader military strikes involving the United States, Israel, and Iran continue.

Middle East.headline: Gaza Strip — Over 70,000 killed as military campaign continues
Middle East.body: Ongoing military operations in Gaza have left the territory in ruins and killed more than 70,000 Palestinians, including many children. An Amnesty International report highlighted that India has become a key part of Israel's weapons supply chain, deepening diplomatic and military ties despite growing international backlash and mounting isolation over the severe humanitarian toll in Gaza.

Middle East.headline: Syria — Return of displaced Kurds suspended after renewed violence
Middle East.body: An organized convoy carrying hundreds of displaced Syrian Kurds attempting to return to the border town of Ras al-Ain was suspended following a fresh outbreak of violence. The movement was intended as the first organized return of displaced residents to the area in seven years. However, renewed fighting forced a halt to the process, leaving families displaced.

Americas.headline: Colombia — Powerful earthquake causes severe destruction and high casualties in west
Americas.body: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia at 7:34 am local time, with its epicenter in Chocó department. The tremors caused extensive structural damage and collapsed buildings across major urban centers, including Cali and Pereira, and were felt in neighboring Venezuela. According to reports, at least 224 people have been killed and thousands are reported missing. Rescue operations are actively underway across impacted areas, including Valle del Cauca and the Eje Cafetero region, with authorities warning that casualty figures are expected to rise further as search efforts continue.

Africa.headline: DR Congo — Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 2,000
Africa.body: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 fatalities in what is reported as the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. According to World Health Organization details reported in media feeds, the outbreak originated in February and has been linked to the Bundibugyo virus strain. Response capacity is being severely stretched, with reports highlighting health workers striking and leaving their posts as cases continue to surge across affected regions.

Europe.headline: Ukraine — Russian air strikes kill at least nine people across multiple regions
Europe.body: Russian forces launched overnight missile and drone strikes targeting multiple Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Dnipropetrovsk. According to Ukrainian officials, the attacks killed at least nine people and wounded dozens of others. Kyiv stated that Moscow utilized North Korean-supplied missiles during the strikes, which are part of an intensifying exchange of long-range aerial attacks impacting civilian populated areas.

Europe.headline: Russia — Ukrainian drone strike on oil refinery kills at least 13
Europe.body: A Ukrainian long-range drone strike targeting the Taneco oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, approximately 1,200 kilometers inside Russian territory, killed at least 13 people, according to local officials. Additional Ukrainian drone attacks targeted Russia's Voronezh and Orsk regions, igniting a fire at a warehouse. The strikes represent one of the deadliest long-range attacks inside Russia since the conflict began, as Ukraine continues targeting economic and industrial facilities.

Asia-Pacific.headline: China — Typhoon Dolphin Causes Mass Evacuations and Severe Flooding
Asia-Pacific.body: Severe flooding triggered by Typhoon Dolphin has impacted eastern and central China, affecting regions including Hubei Province and areas near Beijing. Authorities have evacuated approximately one million people due to rising waters and widespread flood warnings. The disaster has caused extensive transportation disruptions, including the cancellation of hundreds of flights in affected eastern provinces. Inundation continues to pose severe risks to vulnerable communities as weather conditions affect broad swathes of the country.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Myanmar — Fatal Airstrikes Hit Thandwe Township
Asia-Pacific.body: Airstrikes conducted by the Myanmar military in Thandwe Township have reportedly killed dozens of civilians, injured eight others, and left two people missing. The deadly aerial bombardment reflects a broader surge in military airstrikes reported nationwide. Protection risks for non-combatants remain critically elevated across contested areas as aerial bombardments hit civilian-populated locations.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Myanmar — Displaced Persons Killed in Ayeyarwady Airstrike
Asia-Pacific.body: A Myanmar junta airstrike in flood-stricken Ayeyarwady Region killed two displaced brothers. The incident underscores severe protection threats facing populations who are simultaneously enduring severe environmental flooding and targeted military aerial attacks. Displaced communities in vulnerable zones face acute humanitarian and physical safety risks.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Global Health — Ebola Outbreak Deaths Pass 2,000
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: The World Health Organization warns that an Ebola outbreak is outpacing international response efforts after spreading undetected for months. According to WHO statements, the outbreak began in February, long before it was officially declared. The death toll from the virus has now passed 2,000 people as health agencies encounter significant challenges in containing transmission.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: India — Assam Flood Death Toll Exceeds 100
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: In India, floodwaters continue to inundate several districts in the state of Assam, where the confirmed death toll has reached 101 people. Inundation remains widespread across affected areas as local response agencies attempt to reach impacted communities and provide emergency assistance amid ongoing severe weather impacts.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Nigeria — Bauchi Urged to Intensify Cholera Response
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: In Nigeria, the Nigeria Union of Journalists has called on Bauchi State authorities to intensify emergency response measures against an ongoing cholera outbreak. The outbreak poses significant public health risks to local communities, prompting calls for expanded healthcare interventions and sanitation controls across the state.
